title: Paper Runner Config (W5/T9)
description: Config schema for the W5/T9 offline paper runner. Mirrors the required-key contract enforced at runtime by runner.load_config (so the schema and code cannot drift silently). Extra keys are allowed (additionalProperties=true) — the runner ignores them, but downstream code (notebooks, dashboards) may consume them. The 4 kill_criteria keys are the hard floor: the runner refuses to start without them.

cost_bps_rt.description: Round-trip cost in basis points (e.g. 24.0 = 0.24%). 0 disables cost drag.

freq_per_year.description: Annualisation factor for Sharpe / annualised return (e.g. 365*24 for 1h bars).

backtest_max_dd_pct.description: Backtest max drawdown in percent (positive number; the runner takes abs() before comparison with live max_dd_pct).

min_trades_before_kill_check.description: Warm-up trade count before rule 1 (PF floor) is evaluated. Below this, rule 1 is dormant.

min_live_profit_factor.description: Lifetime profit-factor floor. Live PF below this (after warm-up) trips kill rule 1.

max_drawdown_multiple_vs_backtest.description: Multiplier on backtest_max_dd_pct. Live max_dd > N * backtest_max_dd trips kill rule 2.

rolling_20d_sharpe_floor.description: Rolling 20-day Sharpe floor. Below this trips kill rule 3.
